title: ketcher-standalone 3.18.0 (EPAM's Ketcher): licence, NOTICE and copyright from Ketcher's v3.18.0 tag

components.name: ketcher-standalone
components.evidence: Shipped modules (research module log; third_party/notices/inventory.json at 1c2c92c, recorded from the current build, after the Miew and InChI trim, lists the same four files for ketcher-standalone@3.18.0): dist/binaryWasm/main.js, indigoWorker-d22340fa.js, indigoWorker.types-dd55aa65.js and its copy of indigo-ketcher-1.46.0.wasm. Each JS file opens with ' * Copyright 2021 EPAM Systems'. No LICENSE or NOTICE in the npm package (its folder holds only dist/, package.json, README.md, and for ketcher-core/-react a node_modules/). The npm registry's gitHead for 3.18.0 is f4f013e1855b71b0cbd37fc79d55b0cbe51c2371, which is what tag v3.18.0 points to (api.github.com: ref tags/v3.18.0 -> tag object 5f0a0cdd3a1564f3a43f387d3a76e571ae7d05f1 -> commit f4f013e1855b71b0cbd37fc79d55b0cbe51c2371); LICENSE, NOTICE and LICENSE-history fetched at that commit and at the tag are byte-identical. web/package-lock.json's integrity for the package equals the registry's dist.integrity. The repo LICENSE is Apache-2.0 whose appendix is filled in as 'Copyright 2021 EPAM Systems' (inside the licence body, so not a copyright line by subtraction); the copyright line is the banner at the top of every shipped dist file. LICENSE-history says Ketcher version 1 was AGPL-3.0 and version 2 was re-licensed under Apache-2.0 by EPAM; 3.18.0 is Apache-2.0 (package.json "license": "Apache-2.0"). NOTICE lists licence families of Ketcher's dependencies (incl. LGPL-2.1 and MPL-1.0) without naming files; it is reproduced whole, as Apache-2.0 §4(d) asks. Not covered here (other records): main.js inlines rollup-plugin-node-polyfills' events.js (its map); indigoWorker-d22340fa.js (sha256 b417f087027592c35a3a08e486a268c70df8bc63a02d0b4471d1d07ee4c9fcdc) inlines indigo-ketcher's Emscripten glue (its map lists node_modules/indigo-ketcher; the file holds 'wasmBinary', so it is prebuilt and needs a file-keyed record); the wasm is Indigo's.
